entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hey, that Shadow did have something...[n]But what the hell is this? An eye?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh, I just figured it out! This must[n]be how we stop those scythes!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah... Now that I think about it,[n]the statue didn't have eyes...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, how much grosser can he get?[n]So this is gonna stop those things, huh?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Another guard captain probably has it.[n]Let's try checking the other floors, Joker!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sweet, we got both of that bastard's eyes![n]Let's go stop those swingin' things!
